collection.description: A healer asks whether distant communities might protect people from certain illnesses before symptoms begin.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A healer asks whether distant communities might protect people from certain illnesses before symptoms begin.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The village reviews clean water, food storage, and separation during contagious illness.

text_only.reason: food talked about or imagined; the village's stores do not change

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A skeptic points out that a successful preventive measure may leave no obvious proof it worked.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers wonder whether controlled exposure or other techniques could train the body to resist disease, but acknowledge the idea is untested here.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The healer refuses to experiment on villagers without evidence and consent; the council approves the caution.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A parent hopes distant children might receive protections unavailable on Isola.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Another villager fears that wealth or geography might determine who benefits.
